basic_info.description: 2774-2784 Bryant Street presents a rare opportunity to acquire a completely vacant six-unit apartment building in the vibrant Mission District of San Francisco. This unique property consists of 6 3bd units, each with its own separate entrance.  The property provides a clean slate for investors or owner-users seeking a redevelopment project.  The building is ready for renovation, making this an ideal value-add opportunity to reimagine the  units to contemporary standards and maximize rental income. The expansive backyard further enhances the property's appeal, offering potential for outdoor common space or private garden areas for residents.  Located in one of San Francisco's most dynamic and sought-after neighborhoods, the property  benefits from close proximity to public transportation, local parks, and an array of dining and entertainment options. The Mission District's continued popularity with both renters and investors makes this a prime opportunity to transform the building into a highly desirable residential asset. Whether repositioned as a long-term income property or converted for partial owner occupancy, 2774-2784 Bryant Street offers endless possibilities to create value in a thriving urban setting.
